definition: Share of offensive possessions ending in a shot-clock violation.
uncertainty_notes: Possession team attribution and points are structurally validated (0 possessions with uncertain offensive team; possession points reconcile exactly to official final scores in all 50 eligible games). 36.2% of possessions carry an is_ambiguous flag, but that ambiguity is about the boundary mechanism/instant, not about which team had the ball. See team_metric_sensitivity.csv for the measured effect on this metric.

definition: Opponent shots classified 'saved' in the play-by-play -- the play-by-play view of this team's saves.
uncertainty_notes: Agrees with official saves in 99 of 100 team-games.

definition: Shots generated per extra-man opportunity -- man-up shot volume, separated from man-up finishing.
uncertainty_notes: Official box score. The play-by-play man-up tag (shot_type MU / MU_2_PT) lands on GOAL events only -- all 90 tagged events in the season are valid goals -- so the event feed supports a man-up goal count but not a man-up shot count and not a man-up possession count. No penalty-clock state is reconstructed anywhere; the extra-man opportunity is the denominator.

definition: A team time-of-possession metric derived from reconstructed possession spans. NOT BUILT.
uncertainty_notes: Rejected on evidence: span sums recover a median 75% of the official figure with a 0.54-1.00 range and correlate with it at only r=0.58, and team possession SHARE derived from spans differs from the official share by 4.9 percentage points on average. The gap is structural -- a possession's span starts at its first LOGGED event, not at the instant control was gained. Use time_of_possession_official_seconds.

definition: Clears / clear attempts as a possession-linked metric. NOT BUILT as an efficiency model.
uncertainty_notes: Official clear/ride counts are passed through as raw columns, but no possession-linked clearing or riding efficiency is built: the feed logs no clear event, so a clear cannot be tied to a possession boundary, and 36.2% of possessions have an unconfirmed start mechanism -- exactly the field this metric would need.

definition: Lacrosse Reference splits efficiency by how the possession began (defensive stop / ground ball / faceoff). PARTIALLY DEFERRED.
uncertainty_notes: faceoff_start_possession_share is published because faceoff starts are never ambiguous. The full three-way split is deferred: 922 possessions carry start_reason='other_confirmed_control' (team known, mechanism unknown), so a stop-vs-ground-ball split would assign ~21% of possessions to a bucket the feed never established.

definition: Any assist-denominated team metric. UNSUPPORTED.
uncertainty_notes: The feed's shotAssistId is a pre-shot pass indicator, not a confirmed assist, and an unpopulated value is not a negative assertion. No assist metric is computed anywhere.

definition: Schedule-strength-adjusted offensive/defensive efficiency. DEFERRED BY SCOPE.
uncertainty_notes: Explicitly out of scope for Phase 5 (team strength ratings are a later phase). Every efficiency metric in these tables is raw, not opponent-adjusted.
